Webhook.//: Dev/E2E only: allow outbound WebhookNotification to loopback/private targets so local mock endpoints (e.g. the 127.0.0.1 listener in NodeRetryE2ETests) work. Production leaves this unset, so OutboundAddressGuard blocks private/reserved targets (SSRF defense).

Integrations.//: Dev/E2E only. A fixed master key so integrations saved locally survive a restart (production takes its keys from the environment and never from this file), Telegram pointed at the local fake the E2E suite runs, and plain http, any SMTP port and 127.0.0.1 as a Discord host so the suite's fakes can stand in for the real services.
